description: Append-only evidence index for APKs actually tested on a physical Android device. Records must contain the SHA-256 of the APK bytes themselves, never the provenance JSON digest. Historical records without an independently confirmed APK hash are intentionally omitted.

tested_apks.evidence: User-confirmed physical-phone PASS on 2026-10-30 for the Increment 0→1 and Reset 1→0 interactions.
